findings.title: Security incident
findings.summary_md: Apify's status page reports that on 9 and 10 November 2026 an unauthorized third party gained access to parts of its internal systems, with the activity detected on 11 November at 12:13 UTC. Access was cut off and additional monitoring added. As a precaution, Apify revoked some OAuth connections to external integrations including GitHub and said it would rotate tokens if the investigation showed they were affected.

findings.title: Security incident
findings.summary_md: In an update posted 12 November, Apify said an unauthorized third party used a compromised credential on 9 and 10 November to obtain a number of account credentials and access related Apify accounts. The access path is closed and no further attacker activity has been detected since 11 November. Apify revoked some OAuth connections to external integrations as a precaution, rotated critical internal secrets, and is notifying affected users individually; the company also notified the relevant authorities.
